title: 第十三章 沐雨柔的强势第十四章 阵法禁制
content_zh:
“伤势差不多了，就抓紧出发吧，在这耽误的时间已经够多了”
柳辰还没来得及问接下来去哪里，就感觉自己的身体不受控制的飘了起来。
直到飘到距离女子一米左右的位置。
“嗖...”
“啊...”
柳辰感觉自己在空中极速的飞行了起来，这突入其来的变故吓得柳辰不由大叫了一声。
马上柳辰就感觉自己嘴里被灌进一大口风，大叫声变成了咳嗽声。
“之前看你跟妖兽搏斗挺英勇的啊，现在怎么这么胆小了”
一声轻笑从旁边传来。
听到这话柳辰也是被说的脸颊有些发红，这下可算是丢人了。
他也不敢说话，之前被灌一口冷风的教训在前，他只得眯起眼睛向旁边看去。
这一看他才知道，只有自己被吹的头发凌乱，女修则被一个护罩包裹着，没有受到一点影响。
柳辰看了一下，此时他们离地面得有将近百米高，此女就这么凌空带着她飞行。
也不知道是忘了给柳辰加个护罩还是报复他之前的无礼举动。
“凌空虚渡，灵基境修士！”
突然柳辰好像意识到什么，脑海中出现这么一段话。
这是柳辰在书中看到的，修士练气之上是灵基境，对应武者的正式武者境界，可以不借助任何外力进行凌空飞行。
要知道武者到了这个境界还只是可以短暂低空飞行而已。
这使得柳辰再看对方时都带有了一丝敬畏，这可是柳辰梦寐以求想要达到的境界啊，也是柳家一直以来的目标。
柳辰不知道的是在柳辰不注意的时候女子嘴角微微翘起。

不知是看到了柳辰现在的糗样还是因为达到了某些目的。
飞行了大概一刻钟就停了下来，女子带着柳辰就这么漂浮在空中。
“大人，是到了吗？”
柳辰虽然不知道目的地是哪里，但是很显然不是出山脉，因为这位大人的飞行方向是往山脉深处去的。
对于此柳辰是没什么意见的，靠他自己走出去危险太大。
至于让对方把他送出去显然不太现实，一是对方不会听他的，二是他也怕到时候惹怒对方，直接把他丢下，那就就亏大了。
对于柳辰的询问，女子并没有回复，而是抬头向前方看去。
柳辰这才发现前方远处有个黑点正在向他们这边极速飞来。
“小妖铁羽，不知修士大人如何称呼？”
黑点飞近后，柳辰发现这是一只体型接近十米的巨鹰，黑色的羽毛像一把吧利剑，在阳光下闪烁着金属光泽。
给柳辰很强的压迫感，让柳辰有些承受不住，也不知要是它释放全部威压的话该有多么恐怖。
显然这是一头一级妖兽，相当于正式武者境界。
除了对方的实力外最让柳辰惊讶的是这只妖兽居然能说出一嘴流利的人类语言。
content_en:
"The injury is almost done, so hurry up and get going. You've wasted enough time here."
Before Liu Chen had time to ask where he was going next, he felt his body floating uncontrollably.
Until it floated to a position about one meter away from the woman.
"Whoosh..."
"Ah..."
Liu Chen felt himself flying very fast in the air. This sudden change scared Liu Chen and he couldn't help but scream.
Immediately, Liu Chen felt a large mouthful of wind being poured into his mouth, and his screams turned into coughs.
"I saw you were very brave in fighting monsters before. Why are you so timid now?"
A chuckle came from the side.
Liu Chen's cheeks turned red when he heard this, which was considered embarrassing.
He didn't dare to speak. He had been taught a lesson by the cold wind before, so he could only narrow his eyes and look to the side.
At this glance, he realized that only his hair was messy due to the blow, while the female cultivator was wrapped in a protective shield and was not affected at all.
Liu Chen took a look. At this time, they were nearly a hundred meters above the ground, and this woman was flying with her in the air.
I don't know if he forgot to put a protective shield on Liu Chen or if he was retaliating for his previous rude behavior.
"Flying across the void, a monk in the spiritual realm!"
Suddenly Liu Chen seemed to realize something, and this passage appeared in his mind.
This is what Liu Chen saw in the book. Above the monk's Qi training is the spiritual base realm, which corresponds to the official warrior realm of the warrior. He can fly in the air without any external force.
You must know that when a warrior reaches this level, he can only fly at low altitude for a short period of time.
This made Liu Chen look at the other party with a hint of awe. This was the state that Liu Chen dreamed of achieving, and it was also the goal of the Liu family all along.
What Liu Chen didn't know was that the corners of the woman's mouth were slightly raised when Liu Chen wasn't paying attention.
I don't know whether it was because he saw Liu Chen's current embarrassment or because he had achieved some purpose.
After flying for about a quarter of an hour, it stopped. The woman and Liu Chen were floating in the air.
"Sir, are you here yet?"
Although Liu Chen didn't know where his destination was, it was obviously not out of the mountains, because the adult's flight direction was towards the depths of the mountains.
Liu Chen had no objection to this. It was too dangerous for him to go out on his own.
As for asking the other party to send him out, it is obviously unrealistic. First, the other party will not listen to him. Second, he is also afraid of angering the other party. If he just abandons him, it will be a big loss.
In response to Liu Chen's inquiry, the woman did not reply, but looked up and forward.
Only then did Liu Chen realize that there was a black spot in the distance ahead, flying toward them at high speed.
"Little demon Tieyu, I wonder what you call the monk?"
After the black spot flew closer, Liu Chen discovered that it was a giant eagle nearly ten meters in size. The black feathers were like a sharp sword, shining with metallic luster in the sun.
It gave Liu Chen a strong sense of oppression, which Liu Chen couldn't bear. He didn't know how terrifying it would be if it released all the pressure.
Obviously this is a first-level monster, equivalent to the realm of a formal warrior.
Apart from the opponent's strength, what surprised Liu Chen the most was that this monster could actually speak fluent human language.
